positioning: Independent fan guide and tool hub for Heartopia players, built around useful routes, databases, calculators, and mobile-first pages.
style: pastel game guide, practical wiki, friendly but data-dense

logo.rules: Use the heart pin logo for site identity. Do not reuse official Heartopia marks or competitor logos.

typography.heading: Georgia / Times-style serif for guide identity
typography.body: Inter / system sans-serif for tables, tools, and mobile readability
typography.rules: No viewport-scaling font sizes; no negative letter spacing; compact headings inside cards.

media.rules: Every main content route needs a visual or functional asset: interactive map, platform cards, database table, calculator, tracker, or themed image.
media.image_style: bright cozy sim-game isometric scenes and purpose-built diagrams; no blurred stock backgrounds.

components.cards: 8px radius, no nested cards except real tools or modals
components.tools: controls should compute or filter real page data
components.ads: reserved slots only after core answer; never next to copy/download buttons

content.tone: answer first, transparent data snapshot, no fake official claims
content.emoji_policy: light use in small route labels only; avoid emoji as the main UI language
content.ad_sense_risk: thin content if pages are only text summaries; each inner page must include unique data, tool logic, diagrams, or route tables
